platform.name: TQS / Trading QS
platform.north_star: verified useful market/research/product outcomes per unit of owner attention

modules.name: TQS Platform / Core
modules.role: shared IDs, schemas, provenance, time semantics, routing and module contracts

modules.name: TQS Intelligence
modules.role: local collection, normalization, Data Lake, features, anomalies, episodes, account intelligence, research and strategy computation
modules.runtime: Windows local primary node today; Linux/VPS-compatible direction

modules.name: TQS Screener / Cockpit
modules.role: trader-facing visual and action layer; existing ScreenerPRO frontend evolves into this module

modules.name: TQS Knowledge
modules.role: durable observations, cases, hypotheses, validated findings, negative results and educational/product knowledge

modules.name: TQS Research / Strategy Lab
modules.role: reproducible hypotheses, event studies, controls, OOS, walk-forward, stability, costs and StrategySpec runs

modules.name: TQS Briefing / Publishing
modules.role: briefings, streams, course/materials and presentation outputs from canonical intelligence/knowledge

modules.name: TQS Connectors / Data
modules.role: exchange, MOEX, news/event, global data and account adapters plus canonical local storage

runtime_nodes.name: Windows TQS Runtime Node
runtime_nodes.notes: Do not hardcode volatile hardware specs; inspect resource/storage telemetry from runtime diagnostics.

runtime_nodes.name: ChatGPT / AI Orchestrator
runtime_nodes.role: reasoning, research, development, interpretation and orchestration
runtime_nodes.notes: Not an always-on runtime. Local PC state requires an explicit API/runtime/snapshot bridge.

runtime_nodes.name: GitHub / CI
runtime_nodes.role: public-safe code distribution, technical contracts and deterministic verification
runtime_nodes.notes: CI success does not prove a specific Windows runtime is healthy.

runtime_nodes.name: Google Drive
runtime_nodes.notes: Not a raw market database and not liveness evidence.

runtime_nodes.name: TQS Screener / Web Cockpit
runtime_nodes.notes: Consumes canonical Intelligence/Knowledge data; cached page content does not prove backend liveness.

integration_bridges.flow: GitHub -> Launcher -> local install/update -> healthcheck -> rollback on failure
validated research/runtime result -> TQS IDs + provenance -> Google Drive knowledge/case
integration_bridges.purpose: promote durable human-useful knowledge without raw data mirroring

integration_bridges.flow: TQS Intelligence canonical API/snapshots -> TQS Screener/Cockpit
integration_bridges.purpose: visualize and act on one canonical compute layer

integration_bridges.flow: authenticated outbound local publish/sync -> private cloud/control plane -> remote views
integration_bridges.purpose: multi-device access without exposing an unauthenticated local runtime

truth_layers.drive-product-truth: Google Drive: owner intent, decisions, observations, human-readable knowledge/cases/materials
truth_layers.git-technical-truth: GitHub: public-safe code, schemas, technical contracts, tests, PRs and CI
truth_layers.data-operational-truth: Local Data Lake/DB: market, history and research operational data

sync_policy.drive_to_github: public-safe product rules/contracts only; never private Drive content or secrets
sync_policy.github_to_runtime: versioned code + update path + CI-verified contracts
sync_policy.runtime_to_drive: durable human-useful findings/cases/briefings only; never raw market firehose
sync_policy.runtime_to_web: canonical API or authenticated sync bridge with explicit freshness/provenance

forbid_in_public_git: private Drive content or IDs used only for convenience
security.forbid_public_runtime_pattern: Do not expose the local TQS API/port unauthenticated to the public Internet.

development.escalate_only_for: concrete capability gap not honestly executable/verifiable via ordinary Chat + connected tools + CI/runtime bridge
